description.value: A small full-service resort in the village of Sayward offering camping alongside cottages and motel rooms, with an on-site store stocking groceries, liquor, and local produce. A practical resupply point for cyclists on the northern Vancouver Island route, with showers, laundry, and propane available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and serves as strong primary evidence: the amenities sidebar explicitly lists showers, laundry, propane, groceries, and other services; the contact page confirms phone numbers (250.282.3204 / 866.357.0598) and address (1546 Sayward Rd, Sayward, BC V0P 1R0) matching OSM across multiple subpages. Active blog posts referencing community events (Halloween, Thanksgiving fundraisers) confirm the business is currently operating. OSM's internet_access=wlan tag is supplementary and not elevated to an amenity claim since the website does not independently confirm device charging availability.
concerns: OSM has no phone number recorded; phone (250-282-3204 local, 866-357-0598 toll-free) was taken from the website — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
OSM tag is 'caravan_site' but the resort also accommodates tent campers and offers cottages and motel rooms; multi-type property but 'Camping' category remains appropriate for this listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An actively operating, well-equipped resort campground in a remote section of northern Vancouver Island with showers, laundry, propane, and an on-site grocery and liquor store — a highly practical stop for touring cyclists with few alternatives in the area.
